title: Kissed with Sweetness Australian Peas Risotto
description: A low-calorie-friendly, date-night treat featuring buttery, gooey yellow split peas, paired with the salty sweetness of shio-cured ham.
instructions: Heat the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the thinly sliced shallots and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced, stirring occasionally.
Add the yellow split peas and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add 1 cup of vegetable broth and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding broth and stirring until the peas are tender and creamy, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the shio-cured ham and cook for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley and parmesan cheese.
Transfer the risotto to 4 ramekins and top each with a slice of shio-cured ham and a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
